categories.title: New Features
list: Locators, billboards, bounding boxes, and armatures/bones are now supported and round-trip through `.utility.json` export & import.
Cubes and meshes have `Skin Model` (All / Wide Only / Slim Only) and `Render Passes` properties in the element panel.

Display slots have a `Display Override` in the Display panel — point a slot at another model by resource location, with a file picker that turns a picked model file into its resource location (files outside a resource pack are rejected). Turning an override on hides that slot's transform and arm-rotation controls.
Older `.utility.json` files are upgraded automatically when imported.

categories.title: Fixes
list: Undo/redo of arm rotations and other custom display-slot settings now works, and those settings are saved to `.utilityproject` files.
Fixed a Display panel crash that could also leave the arm-rotation sliders missing.
Imported `.utility.json` models are now named after their file.
The custom animation type is only applied inside Utility Model projects.
Assorted `.utility.json` import fixes.

categories.title: Other
list: Now requires Blockbench 5.1.6 or newer.

categories.title: New Features
list: Added a Skin Model preview toggle to the outliner toolbar, letting you filter the viewport to show All / Wide Only / Slim Only variants without changing anything saved in the project.

categories.title: Fixes
list: Fixed animations losing their rotation and inverting keyframes when a utility animation type was reclassified.
Animation type reclassification (`utility.*` names, custom paths) is now scoped to Utility Model Project format only, so other formats' animations are no longer affected.

categories.title: New Features
list: Added Function keyframes on the Effects row and locators.
Utility `.bbmodel` files, backups, and autosaves now open as Utility Model Projects.
Added Convert Project support for the Utility Model format.
Node names are now unique across types, except cubes and meshes.

categories.title: Fixes
list: Fixed dragged-in `.utility.json` files opening as Java Block models.
Fixed dragged-in `.utilityproject` files not opening.
Fixed project properties not being saved.
Fixed backups not using the Utility Model Project format.
Fixed doubled or wrong `.utility.json` export extensions.
Fixed Save Project on imported `.utility.json` files.

categories.title: New Features
list: Blockbench now suggests installing Utility Engine when you open a Utility Model Project without it.

categories.title: Other
list: Utility Engine is now available in the Blockbench plugin browser.
The plugin ID is now `utility_engine`. Files from older versions still open, but custom keybinds for Utility Engine actions need to be set again.
